zh.text: 明天的 FOMC 利率決定在東部時間下午 2:00，沃什的新聞發布會於下午 2:30 開始。能源庫存於上午 10:30 公佈，Oracle $ORCL 也舉行投資者日。

en.text: Tomorrow’s FOMC rate decision is at 2:00 PM ET, and Warsh’s press conference begins at 2:30 PM. Energy Inventories are out at 10:30 AM and Oracle $ORCL also holds its investor day.

zh.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies 行政總裁表示，經濟對許多客戶來說很艱難，燃油價格高企且通脹在損益中頑固偏高。客流量和銷量低於所需水平，整體表現未能反映資產質素或團隊能力，對結果和當前軌跡不滿意。

en.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies CEO stated the economy is tough for many customers with elevated fuel prices and stubbornly high inflation in P&L. Traffic and units below needed levels, overall performance does not reflect asset quality or team capabilities, not satisfied with results and current trajectory.

zh.text: @DiMartinoBooth 表示 Skydance 在裁員前提供自願離職方案，並實施每週5天返回辦公室；洛杉磯縣估計 Paramount 與 Warner Bros. 合併可能在3年內令洛杉磯減少4,500個影視職位。

en.text: @DiMartinoBooth says Skydance is offering voluntary buyouts ahead of layoffs and adopting 5 day in office; LA County estimated the Paramount Warner Bros. merger could cost 4,500 LA film and TV jobs over 3 years.

zh.text: $GS 執行長表示，推動這項技術（AI）所需的基礎設施建設需要龐大資本形成，目前對算力的需求更多，至於建置支出是 5 兆還是 10 兆美元或更多，沒有人真正知道。

en.text: CEO of $GS says there is an enormous amount of capital formations necessary to build the infrastructure to drive this technology (AI), more demand for compute right now, whether $5T or $10T or more on the buildout, nobody really knows.

zh.text: 超大規模雲服務商債券發行量比2024年高出近14倍，還有兩個月。據CNBC報導，亞馬遜AMZN、Meta META、Alphabet GOOG和甲骨文ORCL已發行超過2280億美元債券，超過2025年1080億美元的兩倍，以及2024年的167億美元。

en.text: Hyperscaler bond issuance is nearly 14X higher than 2024, with two months to go. Amazon $AMZN, Meta $META, Alphabet $GOOG and Oracle $ORCL have reportedly issued more than $228 billion in bonds, per CNBC, more than double the $108 billion from 2025 and the $16.7 billion from 2024.

zh.text: @APompliano 宣佈 @cfosilvia 推出以比特幣計價財富與資產的功能，認為美元貶值會扭曲財務狀況，以 $BTC 計價更能清楚反映財富增長，並附上免費試用連結。

en.text: @APompliano announces that @cfosilvia now lets users price their wealth and assets in bitcoin, arguing dollars are devalued and distort the picture of finances while denominating wealth in $BTC gives a clearer view of its growth, with a link to try it free.

zh.text: 美股盤前溫和上漲（標普+0.1%，納指+0.3%），油價上升（布倫特超過115美元，因可能對伊朗進行美國打擊）抵消AI漲幅。等待鷹派維持利率的聯準會決定，以及今日$GOOG $MSFT和明日$AMZN業績。$SKHY因強勁業績及記憶體需求至2030年超過供應而大漲，帶動$MU。$TSLA和$SPCX因合併傳聞上漲，$HOOD因第三季疲弱下跌。標普2026年每股盈餘369美元意味20.9倍本益比（4.8%收益率）相對10年期5.01%，預期緊張緩解後利率下降。對$TSLA保持謹慎，因其估值偏高、盈餘下修，以及自動駕駛技術將成商品。

en.text: US stocks modestly higher pre-market (SPX +0.1%, NDX +0.3%) as rising oil (Brent >$115 on possible US strikes on Iran) offset AI gains. Awaiting hawkish hold Fed and earnings from $GOOG $MSFT today, $AMZN tomorrow. $SKHY surged on strong results and memory demand exceeding supply to 2030, lifting $MU. $TSLA and $SPCX higher on merger speculation, $HOOD weak on 3Q. S&P 2026 EPS $369 implies 20.9x PE (4.8% yield) vs 10y 5.01%, expect ease as tensions fade. Cautious on $TSLA due to extended valuation, negative revisions, AV tech as commodity.

zh.text: @RedDogT3 提醒交易者不要追漲。$SPY 與 $QQQ 已連續三個交易日走勢良好，但 $SPY 仍處於 8 月 4 日以來的區間，771 美元附近是他可能減持的位置。市場預期下午 2 時聯儲局議息維持利率不變的機率約 90%，他警告聯儲局主席 Warsh 若發表意外鷹派言論可能引發拋售，因此會在公佈前降低倉位。他認為 $TSLA 突破 388 美元並站上 397 美元屬真正突破，但已是上漲第四天，不宜追高。他認為 $NVDA、$MU、$SNDK 與 $NBIS 只是破位後的反彈；不會持有 $GOOGL 過業績，其 200 日均線約在 327 美元；$AMZN 的後續動能仍未獲證實；$SPCX 則有攤薄疑慮，140.60 美元為風險控制位。附上影片縮圖。

en.text: @RedDogT3 urges traders not to chase the rally. $SPY and $QQQ have had three constructive sessions, but $SPY is still in a range dating back to Aug. 4, with the $771 area a level where he might trim. With markets pricing about a 90% chance of no rate change at the 2 p.m. FOMC, he warns hawkish comments from Fed Chair Warsh could trigger selling and would reduce exposure beforehand. He sees $TSLA as a genuine breakout after clearing $388 and pushing above $397, but on Day 4 of its advance he prefers not to chase. He calls $NVDA, $MU, $SNDK and $NBIS broken bounces, would not hold $GOOGL through earnings with its 200-day average near $327, sees $AMZN follow-through as unproven, and flags dilution concerns for $SPCX with $140.60 as a risk level. A video thumbnail is attached.

en.text: $KOSPI up 6% overnight and almost back to 6,000. That double bottom… Quoted movie reference for HOPE chart.
